description: Read and triage the ZEN service-desk queue on zenuml.atlassian.net — what tickets are open, who is waiting on a reply, which granted extensions are about to expire. Use for any QUEUE-shaped question: "any new tickets", "who is waiting on me", "did this tenant ever file a ticket", "what came in since a given date", "工单", "谁在等回复", "有没有新工单", or when a paywall/churn analysis needs the support-ticket signal. Read-only. To FULFIL a specific request (write the KV licence, draft the reply) use `extend-space-license` instead. Discriminator, one rule: the question names a specific ticket or hands over a request to fulfil uses `extend-space-license`; the question is about the queue, a time window, "anything new", or who is waiting uses this skill.
